messages:
drew (CEO): Morning all — quick weekly from me. High-level summary: EU Dedicated is live (soft launch), Private pilot kicked off with PharmaCo, and overall platform uptime was 99.6% last week. Two company asks: tighten short-seq latency SLOs and convert pilots to committed Dedicated deals. More details below.

elena (VP Product): Great work team :tada:. I'll post the product roadmap refresh in #product after this thread. Optimize v1.2 deploy is scheduled Tue EOD (feature: smarter batch hints).

mike (CTO): Noted. We saw a tail-latency cluster spike Fri 03:12 UTC tied to a bad policy in the autoscaler — auto-fallback kept customer traffic alive but we need a root cause writeup. Postmortem draft in #incidents.

sarah (Head of Ops): Ops update: EU Dedicated capacity is live; two customers onboarded (AcmeApp, FinSolve). SLA review meeting Wed 14:00 PT. Private pilot: initial infra deployment completed for PharmaCo; customer data flow tests start Thu.

nina (Director, Customer Success): Customer notes: onboarding CSAT for the new Dedicated flows is 4.6/5. Requesting a one-pager for the new Dedicated pricing tiers to share with pilots.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: optimize-service@v1.2 -> prod (deploy id: d-8723) :white_check_mark:

drew (CEO): Top metrics snapshot (quick):
```
- Hosted token growth: +12% WoW
- New MRR (this week): +18% MoM on trials -> paid conversion
- Platform P95 latency (short-gen): 140ms (goal: 120ms)
- Uptime last week: 99.6%
```

drew (CEO): Two company-level priorities for the next 14 days: 1) get short-sequence P95 under 120ms (engineering + runtime + infra), 2) convert at least 3 pilots into Dedicated contracts (sales + solutions). Leads: Mike and Elena for #1, Sarah and Nina for #2. Weekly checkpoint Thu 10:00 PT.

mike (CTO): Action items for runtime: increase KV cache sharing, adjust batching heuristics for seq<128, and add a canary throttling knob. I'll drop PRs Monday and check with infra for rollout window.

elena (VP Product): I'll attach a short eval suite for the latency regression tests. Also proposing a small UX change in the Dedicated onboarding flow to reduce time-to-value.

sarah (Head of Ops): Noted on contracts & SLAs. I'll schedule the pilot-to-contract playbook walkthrough with Sales Ops + Legal.

nina (Director, Customer Success): Happy to run conversion calls. Can we get a single slide for sales with the new Dedicated ROI numbers?

drew (CEO): Yes — finance and product to surface the ROI slide by Tue EOD. Also: small policy update — effective next month we require two-week notice for any Dedicated capacity scale-down requests to avoid churned reservations. We'll formalize in the customer agreement addendum.

mike (CTO): Quick Q: any rollback window needed for optimize-service? ops-bot shows green but want to keep a short rollback window for the first 24 hours.

elena (VP Product): Agree, 24h rollback window is fine. I'll add a blurb to the release notes.

drew (CEO): Thanks everyone. Short follow-ups: please add any blockers to the Thursday checkpoint thread. If you need me for escalations, ping me directly. :eyes:

elena (VP Product): +1 :thumbsup:

mike (CTO): 👍

sarah (Head of Ops): 👍

nina (Director, Customer Success): 👍, will prepare slide

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly-checkpoint scheduled Thu 10:00 PT (channel: #leadership-checkpoint)
